description: This file defines the 'Zoomer' class, which manages animated double-touch zoom gestures, including starting, aborting, and computing zoom states using interpolators.

classes.name: Zoomer
classes.description: A class that handles animated zoom gestures, allowing start, abort, and computation of zoom levels with smooth interpolations.

methods.name: forceFinished
methods.description: Sets the zoom finished state to the provided boolean value.

methods.name: abortAnimation
methods.description: Immediately aborts any ongoing zoom animation and sets the current zoom to the end zoom value.

methods.name: startZoom
methods.description: Initiates a zoom animation from a default of 1.0 to the specified end zoom factor.

methods.name: computeZoom
methods.description: Calculates the current zoom level based on elapsed time and interpolation; returns true if zoom is ongoing.
